title.narrative: Second international industry investment forum in Ethiopia

description.narrative: The purpose of the project is to stimulate public and private investment in the agribusiness sector in Ethiopia. Special focus will be given to the agro-industry, including food processing, leather and leather products, and the textile and garments, which have already proven attractive to foreign investment. This will be done by sensitizing financiers and investors (local as well as international) about the increasingly attractive investment policy framework of Ethiopia and most importantly, by sensitizing potential investors about investment opportunities that the PCP ETH has identified, hence demonstrating UNIDO Technical Cooperation to a wider audience than usual and seeking to scale up for a larger development impact.
